notices.subject: Traffic separation scheme. Separation zones. Precautionary areas. Restricted areas. Changjiang Kou.
notices.body:
3935(P)/22 CHINA - East Coast - Traffic separation scheme. Separation zones. Precautionary areas. Restricted
areas.
Source: UKHO

notices.subject: [Broadcast Warning] HAWAII.
notices.title: [Broadcast Warning] HAWAII.
notices.body:
NORTH PACIFIC.
HAWAII.
1. INTERMITTENT MISSILE FIRING OPERATIONS CONDUCTED
   BY THE PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY (PMRF),
   BARKING SANDS, KAUAI, HAWAII, IN WHISKEY
   188 (W-188) OPERATING AREA. OPERATIONS ARE
   CONDUCTED PERIODICALLY THROUGHOUT EACH WEEK
   IN AREA BOUND BY
   22-00.0N 159-51.0W, 22-00.0N 160-00.0W,
   22-04.0N 160-06.0W, 21-59.5N 160-21.0W,
   22-05.0N 161-35.0W, 22-45.0N 161-25.0W,
   22-56.0N 161-49.0W, 23-34.0N 161-18.6W,
   23-57.0N 160-41.0W, 25-41.0N 161-36.0W,
   26-00.0N 159-58.0W, 25-47.0N 158-15.0W,
   23-54.0N 158-15.0W, 22-20.0N 159-09.0W,
   22-21.0N 159-30.0W, 22-13.0N 159-42.0W,
   22-00.0N 159-51.0W.
2. VESSELS MAY BE REQUESTED TO ALTER COURSE DUE TO
   FIRING OPERATIONS AND ARE REQUESTED TO CONTACT
   "PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE BARKING SANDS" ON VHF
   MARINE BAND CHANNEL 16 PRIOR
   TO ENTERING THE ABOVE BOUNDARIES. IF UNABLE
   TO CONTACT PMRF PRIOR TO ENTERING OR WHILE IN
   THE WARNING AREA, RELAY MESSAGES THROUGH
   U.S. COAST GUARD HONOLULU.
3. VESSELS INBOUND AND OUTBOUND FOR HAWAIIAN PORTS
   WILL CREATE THE LEAST INTERFERENCE TO FIRING
   OPERATIONS AS WELL AS ENHANCE VESSEL SAFETY
   BY PASSING SOUTH OF THE ISLANDS OF KAUAI
   AND NIIHAU DURING SPECIFIED TIMES.
4. CANCEL NAVAREA XII 269/21.

notices.title: [Navigational Warning] Construction of the Woodfibre LNG facility is taking place in Howe Sound at 49 39.909N 123 15.114W.
notices.body:
Marine works - LNG Construction
Construction of the Woodfibre LNG facility is taking place in Howe Sound at 49 39.909N 123 15.114W.
Two floating worker accommodation to support facility construction and commissioning of the Woodfibre LNG facility are at 49 39.650N 123 15.480W.
A Marine Safety Zone has been established around the work site.
All vessels not affiliated with the project are to avoid the Marine Safety Zone.
Operations are active 24 hours a day. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF channels 08 and 16.

ALONG LINE JOINING 49-40.139N 123-14.249W, 49-39.922N 123-14.086W, 49-39.589N 123-14.144W, 49-39.274N 123-15.077W, 49-39.220N 123-15.485W

notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] 19 October 2026, hours 10:00 - 18:00.
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] 19 October 2026, hours 10:00 - 18:00.
notices.body:
Denmark. Kattegat. EK R 18 Jaegerspris. Firing exercises. Warning.
19 October 2026, hours 10:00 - 18:00.
22 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 16:00.
23 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 17:00.
24 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 23:59.
25 October 2026, hours 01:00 - 20:00.
26 October 2026, hours 10:00 - 15:00.
27 October 2026, hours 09:00 - 15:00.
28 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 20:00.
29 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 21:00.
30 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 14:00.
In connection with firing practices in EK R 18 Jægerspris, a temporary prohibited area is established on the sea off the firing practice area in position:

- 55° 52'N - 011° 57'E.

During firing practices, all navigation, anchoring and fishing are prohibited in the area.
Information about firing practices is given by displaying the following signals from one hour before the start of the firing practice until its end:



a)
By daylight, a sphere is hoisted and a white, flashing light is lit (60 flashes per minute) on signal mast 1 and 3. 


b)
 30 minutes before sunset, lights displaying a red and white alternating flash (30 flashes per minute) are lit on signal masts 1 and 3.




- 55° 51,57'N - 011° 57,33'E, Signal mast 1 - at the coast at observationspost Syd.
- 55° 54,00'N - 011° 55,54'E, Signal mast 3 - at the coast of Storehøj.

Information about firing practices is available from Camp Jægerspris, tel.

notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] WORKS IN PROGRESS
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] WORKS IN PROGRESS
notices.body:
WORKS IN PROGRESS
ANTIFER - DIEPPE LE TREPORT OFFSHORE WIND FARM    
IN ACCORDANCE WITH ORDER 28/26/PREMARMANCHE, THE REGULATED AREAS ARE CREATED AND DEFINED AS FOLLOWS :    

1. WORKS AREA DELIMITED BY : 
A 50-06.21N 001-01.67E
B 50-07.66N 001-04.05E
C 50-08.99N 001-02.11E
D 50-13.55N 001-09.64E
E 50-10.17N 001-14.59E
F 50-04.16N 001-04.68E
WITHIN THE WORKS AREA, NAVIGATION, STATIONING, ANCHORING OF VESSELS, CRAFT AND BOATS, FISHING, SWIMMING, UNDERWATER DIVING AND ALL OTHER NAUTICAL ACTIVITIES ARE PROHIBITED.
BY WAY OF EXCEPTION TO THE PRECEDING PROVISION, NAVIGATION BY PROFESSIONAL FISHING VESSELS REMAINS AUTHORISED WITHIN THE WORKS AREA, UNDER THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS :
- FISHING VESSEL WITH OVERALL LENGTH LESS THAN 25 METRES ;
- NAVIGATION SPEED LIMITED TO 12 KNOTS ;
- PERMANENT AIS TRANSMISSION ;
- INTEGRATION OF THE POSITIONS OF THE VARIOUS “REGULATED AREAS” INTO NAVIGATION CHARTS ;
- PRIOR CONTACT WITH THE SURVEILLANCE VESSEL BY VHF (CHANNEL 77), AT LEAST 20 MINUTES BEFORE ENTERING THE REGULATED AREA ;
- COMPLIANCE WITH THE RESTRICTIONS ON USE WITHIN THE WORKS AREA


2. BUFFER AREA DELIMITED BY :

notices.id: PERSIAN GULF - STRAIT OF HORMUZ - AND OM1218
notices.noticeNumber: PERSIAN GULF - STRAIT OF HORMUZ - AND OM1218
notices.region: NAVAREA (Red Sea / Gulf of Aden / Persian Gulf)
notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] PERSIAN GULF
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] PERSIAN GULF
notices.body:
PERSIAN GULF
STRAIT OF HORMUZ
CHARTS BA 2837, 2851, 2858, 2888, 3172, 3174, OM1219
AND OM1218
SULTANATE OF OMAN HAS ISSUED FOLLOWING ADVISORY
1. THE SULTANATE OF OMAN BASED ON ITS RESPONSIBILITIES TOWARD THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ, AND ITS IMPORTANCE TO THE GLOBAL ECONOMY, AND IN ACCORDANCE TO ITS CONTINUED COMMITMENT TO THE INTERNATIONAL LAW AND THE LAW OF THE SEA TO ENSURE FREEDOM OF NAVIGATION IN THE STRAIT WITHOUT IMPOSING ANY TOLLS, IN LINE WITH THE OUTCOMES AND EFFORTS REACHED BY THE UNITED STATES AND ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN.
2. THE SULTANATE OF OMAN HAS WORKED IN COORDINATION WITH THE INTERNATIONAL MARITIME ORGANIZATION (IMO) TO PROVIDE
ALL VESSELS WITH THE OPTION OF A TEMPORARY MARITIME  CORRIDOR DEFINED BY THE COORDINATES LISTED BELOW.
3. THE SAFETY OF NAVIGATION REMAINS THE PARAMOUNT CONSIDERATION.GIVEN THE ELEVATED RISK OF COLLISION IN THE CURRENT ENVIRONMENT,
A GRADUAL AND CONTROLLED EVACUATION OF VESSEL TRAFFIC IS REQUIRED.
4. TO MITIGATE THESE RISKS, THE IMO HAS DEVELOPED A PHASED APPROACH BASED ON GROUPS OF VESSELS WITH THE FULL COORDINATION
OF THE OMANI AUTHORITIES.
5. CURRENT REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE TSS IS NOT SAFE FOR USE AT THIS TIME. BASED ON AVAILABLE INFORMATION FROM THE IMO, TWO TEMPORARY ROUTES MAY BE UTILIZED BY VESSELS DEPARTING THROUGH THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ: ONE SOUTH OF THE EXISTING TRAFFIC SEPARATION SCHEME (TSS) AND ONE TO THE NORTH.
6. VESSELS INCLUDE

notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 68NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia of a tanker stuck by an unknown projecti
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 68NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia of a tanker stuck by an unknown projecti
notices.body:
UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 68NM northeast of Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia of a tanker stuck by an unknown projectile.

All crew are reported safe and have been evacuated. There is no reported environmental impact at time of report.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities are investigating.

Position: 27-48.00N 050-37.00E

notices.body:
Central Gulf: Bahrain - Dredging Operations.
BA Chart: 3736, 3737.
Dredging operation east of Bahrain Steel Terminal will be conducted on 08 of March 2025.
Two Buoys will be shifted on 06 of March 2025 to temporary position as below:
BS 3 26-11.243N 050-41.836E
BS 5 26-11.393N 050-41.653E
A temporary special Mark buoy will be deployed on the position 26-10.733N, 050-41.704E.
Duration of the operation: Approx. 6 Months.
Mariners are advised to exercise extra caution and give a wide berth.
Issuer: MENAS Maritime Operations Centre, Bahrain
Megulite

notices.title: [Navigational Warning] UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman.
notices.body:
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman.
The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report.

Update 001:
UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

Position: 24-35.00N 056-38.00E
